title: How to Convert a Video to HEVC on iPhone (H.264 to H.265)
description: Convert H.264 videos to HEVC (H.265) on iPhone to cut file size, often by about half, at the same resolution. What HEVC is and how to convert in a minute.
h1: How to convert a video to HEVC on iPhone
card_summary: H.264 → H.265 is the biggest free size win for older clips and downloads.
keywords: convert video to hevc iphone, h264 to hevc iphone, convert mp4 to hevc, high efficiency video iphone
quick_answer: HEVC (H.265) stores the same picture as H.264 in fewer bits. Compress Video always exports HEVC: open the H.264 clip, keep the resolution if you want, tap Compress and then Download Compressed. Many H.264 clips come out around half the size.
intro: New iPhone recordings are already HEVC if Settings → Camera → Formats is set to High Efficiency. Downloads, screen recordings from other apps, older videos and anything shot in “Most Compatible” are often H.264.

sections.heading: When not to convert
paragraphs: If the video is for a very old device or a workflow that only accepts H.264, keep the original or lower its resolution instead.

steps.heading: Convert H.264 to HEVC
steps.intro: One pass, no quality settings to guess.

items.name: Open the clip
items.text: Pick the video in Compress Video and check that the codec reads H.264.

items.name: Keep the resolution
items.text: In Compress settings leave the resolution slider at 100% and keep the frame rate if you only want the codec change.

items.name: Compress
items.text: Tap Compress. The result is encoded in HEVC.

items.name: Save
items.text: Compare sizes and tap Download Compressed.

faq.question: Is H.265 the same as HEVC?
faq.answer: Yes. HEVC stands for High Efficiency Video Coding, also called H.265.
